provider: Cloud.ru Evolution Object Storage (ex-SberCloud) — cheapest Russian object rate, VAT-inclusive

free_tier.stated: Single-zone S3 object storage ₽1.1346 per GB per month including 22 % VAT (₽0.93 ex-VAT). Tariff document takes effect 2026-09-28. No volume published.

egress.terms: Not stated in the tariff fragment that was retrievable (the document's traffic annex was truncated at the point of reading). A prior wave (A-A4) recorded Evolution Object Storage's free tier as «первые не тарифицируются» for a small monthly allowance and marked the paid service as metered. Treat egress as UNVERIFIED — do not assume free.

tooling: S3-compatible; endpoint class obs.ru-moscow-1.hc.sbercloud.ru answered 403 to an anonymous list (expected for a private bucket API). rclone `s3`, aws-cli.
chaining: Per-GB, so 5 TB and 20 TB share the rate.
limits_note: The ₽1.1346/GB rate is only for the single-zone class; multi-zone and the cold classes are separately priced and were not captured. Enterprise onboarding (legal entity or individual with Russian card).
reliability_note: Cloud.ru is the rebranded SberCloud and is the largest non-hyperscaler Russian cloud; the technical reliability is not in question. The commercial blocker is that tariff documents are PDFs behind a Russian-language portal, prices are VAT-inclusive for Russian entities, and the egress annex could not be read — so the total cost of ownership is unknown even though the storage line is the cheapest Russian object rate found.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
